direct_official_checks: OSGM15 transforms ETRS89 ellipsoid height to orthometric height
mainland Britain output is ODN height
values are obtained by bilinear interpolation
other areas may use local vertical datums
ODN Offshore is lower quality than on-land ODN
OS recommends OSGM15 with OS Net for high-accuracy orthometric heighting
quality_effect: Separates vertical datum transformation error from terrain-surface model error.
